title: Reconnect a retired computer without reinstalling
when: Connecting a computer whose machine was retired, or one registered to another person
need: Run `yoke connect` again: a retired id is refused before any code exists, and the client swaps in a new machine identity once, says which retired id it replaced, and keeps the retired row on Machines. An active machine owned by someone else still refuses as machine_owner_mismatch until its owner or an admin retires it.
surface: Authorization start refusal, `yoke connect`, setup wizard approval view, `yoke machine register` and setup registration on a local universe.
review: Unit and route tests cover start refusal, one-time swap, older-server delivery refusal and foreign owner; live reconnect proof pending.
